/* v1.5.5 grouped bookings by date */
.admin-date-bookings-v155{display:grid;gap:10px}.booking-date-accordion-v155{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);overflow:hidden}.booking-date-accordion-v155>summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:11px 12px;cursor:pointer}.booking-date-accordion-v155>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.booking-date-accordion-left-v155{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-width:0}.booking-date-accordion-left-v155>div:last-child{display:grid;gap:3px}.booking-date-accordion-left-v155>div:last-child>b{font-size:14px}.booking-date-accordion-left-v155>div:last-child>small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}.booking-date-accordion-arrow-v155{font-size:22px;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .18s ease}.booking-date-accordion-v155[open] .booking-date-accordion-arrow-v155{transform:rotate(180deg)}.booking-date-accordion-body-v155{display:grid;gap:8px;padding:0 10px 10px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.booking-card-inside-date-v155{margin-top:10px;grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.booking-card-inside-date-v155 .booking-main{width:100%}
